exposure: permanent contraception procedure during Cesarean delivery
outcome: completion of partial or total salpingectomy
cohort: Women who underwent Cesarean delivery with planned concurrent permanent contraception procedure
finding: While all women who desired partial salpingectomy had the procedure performed, 18.9% of those desiring total salpingectomy could not have it bilaterally due to adhesions, engorged vasculature, or unspecified reasons.
